notes: Eleven dry cleaners Stan listed on 2026-11-17 (businesses whose Google Maps listing has no website), read from the city's Registered Business Locations dataset (DataSF g8m3-pdis, served from data.sf.gov). Each page's `businesses` carries the storefront's history from the same read: trading names with their location start date as `opened`, a later registration of the same name under a different registrant as `ownership_changed`, and an end date as `closed`. Left out: `ownership_name` (people), building-rental registrations ('... Bldg', 'Apts'), and registrations whose trading name is a person's name. A registration re-filed under a corporation carrying the business's own name (Youngs Cleaners And Alterations Inc, La Post Cleaners) is not counted as a change of ownership. `kind` is read from the registered name ('Cleaners').

coverage.remaining: Only the eleven listed; no citywide read.
